anatomy.flutter: Tabs builds one ActiveIndicator-wrapped track of _TabsTrigger widgets plus a DefaultTextStyle-wrapped content view for the selected TabItem.content — a track (indicator + triggers) and a content slot, exactly Radix's List/Trigger/Content shape.
anatomy.web: TabsPrimitive.Root > TabsList (containing the ActiveIndicator plus TabsTrigger children via useActiveIndicator's DOM query) > TabsTrigger, and TabsPrimitive.Content as the separate panel — the same track+content split, with the identical useActiveIndicator/ActiveIndicator hook Tabs.dart's doc says it shares with ToggleGroup.

api.flutter: Tabs(items: List<TabItem>{label,content}, selectedIndex: int, onChanged: ValueChanged<int>, variant: TabsVariant{standard,line}) — always controlled, and TabItem carries no disabled field and Tabs itself takes no orientation parameter at all.
api.web: TabsPrimitive.Root forwards Radix's own value/defaultValue/onValueChange (controlled or uncontrolled) and orientation (default "horizontal"), with tabsListVariants' default/line cva rungs matching TabsVariant, and TabsTrigger inherits disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 from its className list.

states.flutter: _TabsTriggerState._ink resolves active ? (line ? theme.foreground : theme.primaryForeground) : (hovered ? theme.foreground : theme.mutedForeground), animated via TweenAnimationBuilder<Color?> at MotionDurations.normal/MotionCurves.enter — active beats hover because it is tested first, matching the doc's note that data-active: rules are emitted after hover and win.
states.web: TabsTrigger: 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground ... data-active:bg-transparent group-data-[variant=default]/tabs-list:data-active:text-primary-foreground group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-active:text-foreground', transition-colors duration-normal ease-out — same precedence, same two inks per variant.

disabled.flutter: TabItem has no disabled field and _TabsTrigger has no disabled branch in its build method or state table — a Flutter tab cannot be marked unavailable at all.

interaction.flutter: _TabsState._onKey handles ArrowRight/ArrowLeft (RTL-aware via Directionality), Home and End, wrapping via _move's modulo arithmetic, and only the selected tab is a Tab stop (skipTraversal: i != widget.selectedIndex) — one Focus listener above the whole set, matching a roving-tabindex tab list.
interaction.web: Radix's TabsPrimitive.List/Trigger implement the same WAI-ARIA tabs pattern natively: Left/Right (or Up/Down when vertical) arrow navigation with wrap, Home/End to jump to the first/last tab, and roving tabindex so Tab enters/leaves the list once.

semantics.flutter: Semantics(button: true, selected: widget.active, inMutuallyExclusiveGroup: true, label: widget.label) on each _TabsTrigger — a named, selected member of an exclusive group, exactly role="tab" aria-selected semantics.
semantics.web: Radix TabsPrimitive.Trigger renders role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls wired to its TabsPrimitive.Content panel via Radix's own id plumbing, and TabTarget in Flutter enforces the same 44px minimum the --size-target-min token names on web.
